# Finalization Checklist: Speaker-To-Mic Leakage Control

**Purpose**: Validate that package finalization, leakage status, transcription readiness, and derived-artifact requirements are complete before task generation.
**Created**: 2026-06-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are finalization requirements complete for every terminal leakage status: `clean`, `leakage_detected`, `unproven`, `not_measured`, and `not_applicable`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010.1, Data Model §LeakageFinalization]
- [x] CHK002 Are requirements complete for deciding when finalization was attempted versus when measurement was skipped or could not apply? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010.1, Research §Decision: Preserve Five Leakage Statuses]
- [x] CHK003 Are transcription-readiness requirements complete for clean original evidence, contaminated original evidence, unproven evidence, not-measured evidence, and validated derived evidence? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010a.1, Spec §FR-011, Research §Decision: Transcription Readiness Fails Closed]
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements complete for packages with missing, empty, failed, or unsupported original tracks before finalization assigns readiness? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Quickstart §Scenario 4]
- [x] CHK005 Are requirements complete for finalizing packages whose `mic.wav` and `incoming.wav` have different durations, drift, missing padding, or unknown alignment? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Spec Edge Cases, Data Model §TimelineAlignment]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is the boundary between `unproven` and `not_measured` specific enough that tasks cannot implement either as a generic "unknown" state? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010.1, Research §Decision: Preserve Five Leakage Statuses]
- [x] CHK007 Is `clean` defined as a proven measurement result rather than a default state when no failure is found? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010.1, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK008 Is `leakage_detected` defined with enough threshold and confidence detail to avoid subjective judgment during finalization? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010.1, Research §Decision: Thresholds Are Versioned And Multi-Dimensional]
- [x] CHK009 Is `not_applicable` bounded to package/artifact types where leakage truly cannot apply, rather than ordinary measurement failure? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010.1, Data Model §LeakageFinalization]
- [x] CHK010 Is "authoritative status after stop" clear enough to prevent preflight, route class, in-progress UI, or live processing from setting final cleanliness? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010a, Spec §SC-019]
